title: [SOLVED] Listing every package which has a specified dependency
body: Is there a way to list all packages which have a specified package as a dependency in the terminal? The man page for pacman says that pacman -Sii [package] does this exact thing, but it does not. For example, if I run pacman -Sii python the returned list includes packages such as groovy, passenger, ruff, and valabind, which are related to Python, but do not have it as a dependency. Edit: Nevermind, I'm an idiot and thought I was running a different command than I was. The man page is correct. Last edited by melodian (2026-10-22 01:29:24)
